recommended_approach: Drive the simulation through Blender’s Fluid RNA types: use a gas fluid Domain (configured via `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings`) plus one or more Flow objects (configured via `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings`). For higher-frequency detail in the resulting fire, use the domain’s noise-related controls (`FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength`, `FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim`) and, on the flow source, its `FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture` input to modulate emission. (The retrieved Blender 5.0 references available here are primarily API index entries pointing to these settings rather than full narrative Mantaflow setup documentation.)
